text:
Maria K: Heads-up: CI failing on helm lint for charts/training-pool. Linter complains about values.schema requiring gpu.autoscaler.* when gpu.enabled is false. Error: `schema error: required property "minReplicas"`. Anyone seen this? /cc @Sam P @Jin L

Sam P: Yep, saw that in the last deploy. It's because our values-schema uses `anyOf` incorrectly — the GPU sub-schema doesn't use the `if: { properties: { enabled: { const: true } }}` pattern, so when enabled:false the validator still expects `minReplicas`. Quick workaround: set `gpu.autoscaler.minReplicas: 0` in overlays. But we shouldn't need that.

Jin L: I'm pretty sure the root cause is our `helpers.tpl` where we `default 1 .Values.gpu.count` — when gpu is nil it coalesces to 1 and then templating generates autoscaler annotations and HPA fields. The schema and templates disagree.

Maria K: Exactly. CI shows: `helm template . --values ci-empty.yaml | kubeval` logs: autoscaler target mismatch. Copy of failing snippet: ```yaml
annotations:
  cluster-autoscaler.kubernetes.io/scale-down-disabled: 'false'
```
But the real problem is `hpa.minReplicas` getting rendered when not intended.

Ryan H: Can we add a safe-coalesce helper `coalesceNumeric` that returns nil if parent map is missing? e.g. `{{- define "redwood.coalesceNumeric" -}} {{- if hasKey .  }}{{ . }}{{- else -}}null{{- end -}} {{- end }}` Might be tricky in Helm but would centralize behavior.

Sam P: Helm templating doesn't do nulls well. We usually guard with `if .Values.gpu.enabled` before rendering autoscaler block. There's an older chart that forgot the guard. Proposed fix: wrap the entire HPA block with `{{- if and .Values.gpu (or .Values.gpu.enabled (ne (kind .Values.gpu) "nil")) }}` — ugly but safe.

Jin L: :thumbsup: I pushed a quick patch to branch `fix/gpu-hpa-guard` and added unit tests in chart-testing to render with `--values empty.yaml` and with `gpu.enabled: false` to ensure no hpa fields generated. Also updated `values.schema.json` to use `if/then/else` so that `minReplicas` is required only when `enabled` is true. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/charts/pull/422

Maria K: Nice. Two follow-ups: 1) can the linter CI detect the template coalescing bug? 2) Cost question — if autoscaler minReplicas defaults to 1, we double-spend GPUs in eu-west. Might need a telemetry alert or a rule in infra to fail fast on unexpected minReplicas > 0 in non-prod.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: chart-testing pipeline for `training-pool` failed in CI on staging; job 2301. See logs: https://ci.internal/build/2301 :warning:

Ryan H: I'll add a rule to our chart-lint job to run `helm template` with two fixtures: one where `gpu: {}` and one where `gpu` is omitted. Can't use /dev/null in CI, so add `ci-fixtures/empty-gpu.yaml`. Also adding an e2e smoke deploy to the sandbox k8s to detect `minReplicas != 0` early.

Sam P: Also note: autoscaler/batching config `batchSize` was being pulled from `values.inference.batchSize` but our runtime expects `batch.size` path. I added a small mapping helper in `helpers.tpl` to normalize old paths to the new schema. Will include a migration note in the PR.

Maria K: Thanks team. Let's merge the PR after chart-tests pass. If anyone finds related chart drift across regions (eu vs us), ping infra oncall. :rocket:
